title: 048-N1 · Transfer team reports a plan, not handover
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Ari Veld, the recipient. From the case card: the international carrier has a recorded clearance release for DL-048, but the last-mile carrier has not yet confirmed receipt. Our task is to get the physical handover established, not to deliver the parcel.
